
{{alias}}( x, y, p )
    Computes the log loss gradient with respect to a model parameter.

    If any argument is `NaN`, the function returns `NaN`.

    If `y` is not +1 or -1, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    y: number
        True target value.

    p: number
        Predicted value.

    Returns
    -------
    v: number
        Log loss gradient.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 2.3, 1.0, 0.782 )
    ~-0.722
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.4, 1.0, 0.202 )
    ~-0.63
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.0, 1.0, -0.999 )
    ~-0.731
    > v = {{alias}}( -3.2, -1.0, 0.2 )
    ~-1.759
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.0, NaN, 0.987 )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
